purpose: Validate the NumPy cell-integrated periodic Gaussian LOS convolution oracle before any JAX promotion or CF4 posterior execution.
final_project_goal: Use CF4 constraints to obtain a statistically valid z=0 local-universe density/velocity posterior, construct an exact q-corrected IC with conditional high-k structure, and forward-validate a zoom IC at an effective observational resolution of <=0.3 cMpc/h.

implementation.operator_equation: lambda_pc = E_epsilon [ sum_i m_pi W_TSC(c, (s_i + h*sigma_i*epsilon*rhat_i/(aH)) mod L) ]
implementation.method: Piecewise polynomial TSC stencil integration against standard-normal moments through degree six; no finite-order point-deposit quadrature in the oracle.
implementation.selection_order: Exposure is applied only after the exposure-free convolution.

verification.independent_adaptive_reference: PASS but semi-independent and limited: one representative source per boundary/non-boundary fixture is compared with SciPy adaptive vector integration. The committed checks do not yet establish a dedicated sigma>L extreme multi-wrap gate or all-population coverage.
verification.reproducible_legacy_candidate_gate: PASS; committed tests apply q1_candidate_oracle_gate to actual GH3/GH7/GH9/GH15 candidates on both fixtures and reject all of them.
verification.oracle_numerical_stability_fix: Local epsilon-minus-midpoint polynomial basis plus vector tail moments; negative clipping tightened to 1e-13. Sliver merge is 1e-10 in epsilon and still requires a pre-renormalization defect bound in Q2.

boundary_fixture.mass_gate_interpretation: By-construction after per-particle renormalization; not independent evidence of convolution accuracy.

nonboundary_fixture.mass_gate_interpretation: By-construction after per-particle renormalization; not independent evidence of convolution accuracy.

driver_audit.summary: Q1 NumPy oracle and mass/independent-reference checks pass. Existing point-deposit GH operators fail the new candidate-versus-oracle diagnostic by large margins; no downstream science is authorized.

fable_plan_audit.summary: The Q1 plan is a direct numerical prerequisite but not sufficient for the final CF4-to-IC goal. Operator, comparison target, tolerances, exposure order, gradient gates, and performance gates were frozen before implementation.

independent_agy_audit.summary: Operator, local polynomial integration, periodic handling, actual GH candidate tests, mass/exposure ordering, and downstream blocking pass. Dedicated extreme multi-wrap coverage is required in Q2.

independent_opus5_audit.summary: Q1 operator and GH diagnostics are sound, but adaptive validation is semi-independent/limited and mass conservation is by-construction after renormalization.
required_next_gates: dedicated sigma>L multi-wrap fixture with uniform-field check
all six populations and at least three sources per fixture in adaptive reference
pre-renormalization mass defect and dropped-sliver probability bounds
remove unsupported multi-wrap claim from result records

science_decision.reason: NumPy reference is validated, but JAX agreement, AD gradient agreement, calibrated selection/LF/bias/HOD/model-discrepancy mocks, coverage, and held-out frontier are not evaluated.

next: Q2 plan must include the agy/opus5 requirements: a dedicated sigma>L multi-wrap fixture, all-population adaptive checks, pre-renormalization mass/sliver bounds, frozen clip/sliver constants, and tail 6/8/10 convergence. Q2 implementation remains separately held by its fable-approved preflight and Q1 baseline conditions.
